🔻 President Pezeshkian says Iran will not bow to US, Israeli bullying 📌 Mashhad, IRNA – President Masoud Pezeshkian says Iranians will stand firm in defending their country and will not bow to pressure from the United States and the Israeli regime, stressing that national unity is essential to overcoming external challenges. Speaking during a visit to Razavi Khorasan Province on Wednesday night and Thursday morning, Pezeshkian said the Iranian people have stood and will continue to stand to the last breath in defense of their country, and they will not bow to the bullying of the United States, the Zionists or others. ​ He said that despite sanctions, military aggression and pressure imposed by Washington and Tel Aviv, significant progress and achievements had been made under difficult circumstances. ​ The president said Iran’s adversaries were seeking to prevent its development by intensifying economic pressure and exploiting social divisions to advance their objectives. ​ He called on people from all political and social backgrounds to set aside differences and cooperate in managing the country, warning that internal divisions would serve the interests of its adversaries. ​ Pezeshkian also addressed the need to resolve the current “neither war nor peace” situation, saying that determining the country’s course did not necessarily mean choosing war. ​ Any decision, he said, should take into account national capabilities, available resources, potential consequences and a clearly defined final objective. ​ He stressed that the country needed a common understanding through domestic dialogue before moving forward together toward the goals set by the Leader of the Islamic Revolution Ayatollah Sayyid Mojtaba Hosseini Khamenei. ​ Leaving the current situation unresolved, he added, would keep the country in uncertainty and prevent it from pursuing a clear path forward, Pezeshkian added. 📲 @Irna_en ​

🇮🇷 🇱🇾 ⚡ An Iranian Cargo Ship Targeted Off the Coast of Libya! The Italian newspaper "Corriere della Sera" reported that an Iranian cargo ship named "Alvan" was targeted during recent attacks on Russian vessels in the port of Benghazi, Libya. According to the report, the ship was allegedly hit by a drone on either November 22nd or 23rd, but unlike some initial reports, it did not sink. Satellite images also show that the vessel moved towards the Benghazi port pier after the incident. According to two informed sources cited by Corriere della Sera, the Alvan was carrying electronic components manufactured in China and India, intended for use in drone systems. It is said that this cargo was being sent to the Libyan National Army forces, led by Khalifa Haftar, in eastern Libya. Unlike the attacks on two Russian vessels in Benghazi, for which Volodymyr Zelenskyy claimed responsibility, no party has yet claimed responsibility for the attack on the Iranian ship. Corriere della Sera suggests that a Ukrainian operational team may have been involved in the attack, possibly as part of cooperation with the United States.
